chunks: Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ali ibn Sulayman, who said:
I wrote to the Man (peace be upon him), 'What do you say regarding the Prayer of Glorification in the carriage?' So he (peace be upon him) wrote: 'When you are traveling, so pray.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on performing Salat al-Tasbih while traveling?
ai.summary: This brief correspondence from Imam al-Ridha (peace be upon him) clarifies the permissibility of performing Salat al-Tasbih during travel, emphasizing the flexibility of Shia jurisprudence regarding voluntary prayers in transit. It reflects the practical application of ease (yusr) in ritual observance, confirming that the specific conditions of travel do not negate the merit of this devotional act.
